title: Want to stop AI from destroying the world? Make it Open Source
excerpt: Because the overall upside is greater than the doomerism, transparency is one of the best disinfectants humans know of. Encryption used to be considered too dangerous, yet here we all are, safer on the internet because of free and open encryption.
content_html:
Because the overall upside is greater than the doomerism, transparency is one of the best disinfectants humans know of. Encryption used to be considered too dangerous, yet here we all are, safer on the internet because of free and open encryption.

What if instead of seeing the agents as more helpful to the red team, we see them as more helpful to the blue team? In other words, we'll be able to fix security issues without having to be granted access to some model controlled by a few ultra wealthy people. The guardrails they have to stop hacking also stops people working to improve their code security, and also when they get hacked, re: HF incident and needing to turn to Chinese Ai after American Ai refused to help. Actually open Ai is here, it's on the internet, GLM 5.3 has been shown to be nearly as capable as Mythos when given a better harness. I find it highly unlikely the US will be able to convince China to stop making their models open and available to everyone. A, that's not their ethos, B the US has been and is increasingly hostile towards them in the Ai space.

I for one look forward to a world where China leads the US in Ai. I think it is a shock we need to break out of the funk we are in. I also think they are being both more responsible and building towards a future where not just a few elite control one of the most significant technologies humans have engineered.
